items.title: Asked Nick Nurse what he saw from Jabari Walker.
items.author: Adam Aaronson
items.body_excerpt:
Asked Nick Nurse what he saw from Jabari Walker.

“Played good. Same. He just goes out there, plays hard, plays well, and has an impact. He just seems to play well every time he hits the floor.”

Asked him if he would play Walker over Adem Bona.

“I’m not at that point yet, no.”
